description: This file provides utility functions for filtering course/path listings by excluding items based on their title or slug. It includes functions to determine if an item should be excluded, to filter a list of items, and to retrieve default exclusion lists.

methods.name: shouldExcludeItem(item, options = {})
methods.description: Determines whether an item should be excluded based on specified excluded titles or slugs, case-insensitive.

methods.name: filterList(list, options = {})
methods.description: Filters a list of items, excluding any that meet the exclusion criteria defined by shouldExcludeItem.

methods.name: getDefaultExclusions()
methods.description: Returns the default set of titles and slugs to be excluded globally across the application.
